text_en:
China's Shanghai Composite Index closed down 2.78 points, or 0.07%, at 3,885.33 on Monday, September 14;
China's Shenzhen Component Index closed down 86.69 points, or 0.64%, at 13,384.57 on Monday, September 14;
China's CSI 300 Index closed down 30.07 points, or 0.67%, at 4,480.08 on Monday, September 14;
China's ChiNext Index closed down 36.46 points, or 1.1%, at 3,285.58 on Monday, September 14;
China's STAR 50 Index closed down 25.12 points, or 1.62%, at 1,528.27 on Monday, September 14.
